info.title: sparkplug-agent ingest API
info.summary: HTTP raw-tag front door of the sparkplug-agent (ADR-0042 Mode A).
info.description:
A connectivity plane (a client's Node-RED tee or the Go PLC readers) POSTs plain-JSON raw-tag envelopes here; the agent resolves them against the tenant's tag map, assigns SparkPlug aliases and publishes SparkPlug B upstream. Served by the `sparkplug-agent` binary on its ingest listener (AGENT_INGEST_PORT, default 9104, plaintext HTTP) when AGENT_HTTP_INGEST_ENABLED=true. `/healthz` and `/metrics` live on the agent's separate health listener (HEALTH_PORT).

Two modes, fixed at start-up:
- Single-tenant (`--config <client.yaml>`): an envelope that declares a different group is 403; an envelope with no group is accepted. `X-Ingest-Group` is ignored. `POST /v1/counters` exists only in this mode and only when AGENT_NUMERIC_INGEST_ENABLED=true (404 otherwise).
- Multi-tenant (AGENT_TENANTS_DIR, e.g. `sparkplug-agent-shared`): the group is mandatory. The body's `group`/`group_id`/`tenant` wins, else the `X-Ingest-Group` header, else 403; an unknown group is 403.

Public hosts (staging only; the agent is not deployed by the production compose file):
- `https://ingest.staging.packiot.app:8449/v1/tags` -> sparkplug-agent-shared. Exact path only; the security group admits 8449 from registered box egress addresses only.
- `https://cpack-ingest.staging.packiot.app:8447/v2/tags` -> sparkplug-agent-shared `/v1/tags`, with nginx injecting `X-Ingest-Group: CPACK`. `/v1/tags` on that host is closed (444). Port 8447 is admitted for CPACK's egress address only.
Neither public host proxies `/v1/counters` or `/openapi.json`.

On-prem edge boxes run the same agent with the listener published on the box loopback (127.0.0.1:9104).

## How to call this API

- **Auth**: send the shared ingest key in `X-Ingest-Key: <ingest-key>` on every request. A missing or wrong key is 401; the key is compared in constant time and never logged.
- **Base URLs**: see `servers`. Client tees use the public staging front door (`https://ingest.staging.packiot.app:8449`, `/v1/tags` only, source-IP allowlisted); services on packiot-net use the in-network address; on-prem readers use the box loopback `http://localhost:9104`. There is no production deployment.
- **Content types**: request bodies are `application/json` (max AGENT_INGEST_MAX_BODY_BYTES, default 1 MiB). Unknown fields are ignored. Successful responses are `application/json`.
- **Errors**: handler errors are `application/json` bodies `{"error":"<message>"}` with the messages listed per operation. A wrong HTTP method on a known path is a 405 from Go's router (`text/plain`, `Method Not Allowed`, with an `Allow` header) and an unmounted path is a 404 (`text/plain`, `404 page not found`); both happen before the key is checked.
- **Retries**: on a network error or 5xx from a proxy, re-send the same envelope. Readings are absolute values at a timestamp, so a retry repeats samples instead of adding to them. A `link` report is counted once per accepted request, so a retried envelope counts its PLC tick twice in that minute.
- **Docs**: browse this spec in the API docs portal at https://api.staging.packiot.app/docs/ (behind the cs-admin SSO, read-only Swagger UI). It is also exported to `docs/api/openapi/sparkplug-agent.openapi.json` in packiot-stack-alpha.

tags.name: ingest
tags.description: Front door for factory readings: raw tag envelopes (`POST /v1/tags`) and the legacy numeric counter shape (`POST /v1/counters`). Both feed the agent's tag pipeline, which publishes SparkPlug B upstream.

post.description:
Accepts one scan's worth of PLC readings from a connectivity plane (a client's Node-RED tee or the Go PLC reader).

**Order of checks**: `X-Ingest-Key` (401) → body read under AGENT_INGEST_MAX_BODY_BYTES (default 1 MiB; over the cap → 413; unreadable or empty → 400) → tenant routing / scope (403) → envelope decode (400) → optional PLC link report recorded → tags fed to the tenant pipeline → 202.

**Tenant scoping**: single-tenant agents accept an envelope with no group and reject a different declared group (403 `out-of-scope group`). Multi-tenant agents (the shared staging front door) require a group from the body (`group`, then `group_id`, then `tenant`) or, failing that, the `X-Ingest-Group` header; a missing or unknown group is 403. One tenant's tags can never reach another tenant's pipeline.

**Side effects**: each tag whose metric suffix is in the tenant's tag map is written to the agent's in-memory tag store under the equipment's SparkPlug topic and published upstream as SparkPlug B data (the cloud decoder then writes it to the database). Tags not in the tag map are dropped and counted in a metric, not rejected, so `accepted` may be lower than `total`. When the body carries `link` with `endpoint` and a positive `scan_ts`, one PLC connection tick is added to `silver.plc_link_minutes` (tenant × endpoint × minute; used to tell "PLC unreachable" apart from "line stopped").

**Idempotency**: not deduplicated. Readings are absolute values at a timestamp, so re-posting repeats samples rather than adding to them; the link tick is counted again.

**Limits**: one body ≤ AGENT_INGEST_MAX_BODY_BYTES (default 1 MiB). No rate limit. An empty `tags` list is valid (a heartbeat, or a failed PLC read reported only through `link`).

scan.summary: One PLC scan with four readings and a healthy link

failedRead.summary: PLC read failed: no tags, link report only

headerRouted.summary: No body group: routed by the X-Ingest-Group header (multi-tenant)

requestBody.description: One raw tag envelope. Tag names are metric suffixes; the agent prepends the equipment topic from the tenant's tag map.

202.description: Envelope accepted and fed to the tenant pipeline. `accepted` < `total` means some tags were not in the tag map (dropped, not an error).

accepted.description: Tags that resolved to a mapped metric and were applied.

400.description: `cannot read body`, `empty body`, or `undecodable envelope` (malformed JSON, a tag with an empty `metric`, or a non-scalar `value`). Nothing is fed to the pipeline. Note: on a multi-tenant agent, malformed JSON without an `X-Ingest-Group` header is a 403 `missing group (...)` instead, because routing runs before decoding.

undecodable.summary: Bad JSON, empty metric or non-scalar value

413.description: `payload too large`: the body exceeds AGENT_INGEST_MAX_BODY_BYTES (default 1 MiB). Nothing is fed to the pipeline.

post.summary: Ingest a legacy numeric counter envelope
post.description:
Single-tenant agents with AGENT_NUMERIC_INGEST_ENABLED=true only; otherwise this path is not mounted (404). Not proxied by any public host.

Accepts the legacy `counterData: [{id, value}]` shape (flat, or nested per endpoint under `counters`; both are flattened into one list), translates each numeric count index to a canonical tag through the tenant's count-index table, and feeds the same pipeline as `POST /v1/tags` (ADR-0045 option B).

**Order of checks**: `X-Ingest-Key` (401) → body read under the cap (413 over it, 400 unreadable or empty) → scope check (403 when a declared `group`/`group_id`/`tenant` differs from the agent's scope; an absent group is accepted) → envelope decode (400) → translate → 202.

**Side effects**: translated tags are applied to the tag store and published upstream as SparkPlug B, exactly like `/v1/tags`. Count ids with no canonical metric are counted (`unmapped_index` and a Prometheus counter used as an onboarding data-quality signal), not rejected. No `link` reporting on this route.

**Timestamps**: per-counter `ts`, else the envelope `timestamp`, else `scan_ts`. Always send one of them; with none, the reading carries timestamp 0.

**Endpoint**: every counter is attributed to the envelope `endpoint` (or `gateway`); the per-group `counters[].endpoint` is accepted but not used for translation.

**Idempotency**: not deduplicated; counter values are absolute, so a retry repeats samples.

**Limits**: same body cap as `/v1/tags` (default 1 MiB). No rate limit.

requestBody.description: Legacy numeric counter envelope (flat `counterData`, nested `counters[].counterData`, or both).

202.description: Envelope accepted, translated and fed to the pipeline.

unmapped_index.description: Counter ids with no canonical metric (dropped and counted).

400.description: `cannot read body`, `empty body`, or `undecodable counter envelope` (malformed JSON or a field of the wrong JSON type).

undecodable.summary: Bad JSON or wrong field types

403.description: `out-of-scope group`: the body declares a group other than the agent's scope.

404.description: The agent is multi-tenant or AGENT_NUMERIC_INGEST_ENABLED is not true, so the route is not mounted (Go router, before auth).

413.description: `payload too large`: the body exceeds AGENT_INGEST_MAX_BODY_BYTES (default 1 MiB). Nothing is fed to the pipeline.

ingestKey.name: X-Ingest-Key
ingestKey.description: Shared ingest key (AGENT_INGEST_API_KEY), compared in constant time. The agent refuses to start the listener without a key. Never logged.

IngestGroup.name: X-Ingest-Group
IngestGroup.description: Multi-tenant mode only: routing key used when the body carries no `group`/`group_id`/`tenant`. Case-insensitive. A per-tenant nginx front door sets it (cpack-ingest injects its tenant's group). Ignored in single-tenant mode.

Forbidden.description: Tenant routing/scope rejection: `out-of-scope group` (single-tenant: the body declares another group), `missing group (multi-tenant mode requires it in the body or the X-Ingest-Group header)`, or `unknown group` (multi-tenant: no pipeline for that group). Nothing is recorded.

missingGroup.summary: Multi-tenant agent, no body group and no header

value.error: missing group (multi-tenant mode requires it in the body or the X-Ingest-Group header)

MethodNotAllowed.description: Wrong HTTP method for this path. Produced by Go's router before the key is checked; carries an `Allow` header.

error.description: Human-readable error message (stable strings, listed per response).

RawTagEnvelope.description: Tier-1 raw-tag envelope (ADR-0042 section 2.3). Tag names are metric SUFFIXES; the agent prepends the equipment's topic. Unknown fields are ignored.

group.description: Tenant SparkPlug group. `group_id` and `tenant` are accepted as aliases (first non-empty wins).

tenant.description: Alias of `group` (used when `group` and `group_id` are empty).

endpoint.description: Connectivity endpoint/device the readings came from.

scan_ts.description: Scan time, unix milliseconds; default for tags without `ts`.

value.description: Scalar reading. The SparkPlug datatype comes from the tag map, not from this JSON type.

param.description: Parameter id carried by an id-bearing Parameter metric (e.g. 30701); 0 or absent means none.

tags.description: Readings of this scan. May be empty.

link.description: Optional PLC connection report for this scan. Recorded only when `endpoint` and a positive `scan_ts` are present and the request passed auth and routing.

ok.description: true when the scan connected to and read the PLC.

CounterEnvelope.description: Legacy numeric counter body. Both `counterData` and nested `counters[].counterData` are flattened into one list. Unknown fields are ignored.

group.description: Checked against the agent's scope when present (`group_id`/`tenant` are aliases).

gateway.description: Used as the endpoint when `endpoint` is empty.

endpoint.description: Connectivity endpoint the counters came from; falls back to `gateway`.

scan_ts.description: Envelope time, unix milliseconds (used when `timestamp` is absent).

endpoint.description: Endpoint of this group. Accepted but currently not used: translation uses the envelope `endpoint`/`gateway` for every counter.

counters.description: Counters grouped per endpoint; flattened together with `counterData`.
